arStrings.szText:
Every {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} seconds, the next damage you deal inflicts {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} for {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds. Damaging an enemy afflicted with {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} deals an additional {c_random}{SF_13}{/c} Shadow damage and transfers their Hex to another target. 

A single {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} may only be transferred {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} times. {if:SF_2}Afterwards, it cleanses all negative effects from you and grants {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c}.{/if}
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
After a {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} reaches its maximum transfers, it cleanses all negative effects from you and grants {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c}.
